title: AI Consilium: a Benchmark of LLM Clinical Multidisciplinary Second Opinions
abstract: arXiv:2610.22298v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate differential diagnoses for complex cases, but a useful second opinion must also be factually grounded, clinically coherent, actionable, and safe. We developed a multidimensional benchmark using 300 diagnostically resolved NEJM--MedQA cases: 110 for physician reference ratings and Judge calibration and 190 for held-out evaluation. Eight single-model pipelines generated independent role-specific opinions and interactive-consilium reports under free-form and structured clinical-reasoning conditions. A physician-calibrated LLM Judge evaluated 3,040 final reports and the corresponding structured primary-role outputs. Model identity separated report quality more strongly than response format. Structured final reports had higher overall mean scores in seven of eight model pipelines, with their clearest advantage in management (2.740 vs. 2.436). translated_title: AI Consilium：大语言模型临床多学科第二意见基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）能够为复杂病例生成鉴别诊断，但一个有用的第二意见还必须具备事实依据、临床连贯性、可操作性以及安全性。我们基于300个已明确诊断的NEJM-MedQA病例构建了一个多维基准测试：其中110个病例用于医生参考评分和评审模型（Judge）校准，190个用于保留评估。八条单模型流水线在自由格式和结构化临床推理两种条件下生成了独立的角色专属意见和交互式会诊（consilium）报告。一个经医生校准的LLM评审模型对3,040份最终报告及相应的结构化主角色输出进行了评估。结果显示，模型身份比响应格式更能显著区分报告质量。在八条模型流水线中，有七条的结构化最终报告获得了更高的总体平均分，其中在治疗管理方面的优势最为明显（2.740 对 2.436）。与结构化的会诊前主角色输出相比……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究构建了AI Consilium多维基准，用于评估大语言模型生成临床多学科第二意见的能力，发现模型身份比响应格式对报告质量影响更大，且结构化报告在八条模型流水线中的七条上表现更优，尤其在治疗管理方面优势显著。
en_tdlr: The study introduces AI Consilium, a multidimensional benchmark for evaluating LLM-generated clinical multidisciplinary second opinions, showing that model identity influences report quality more than response format, with structured reports outperforming free-form ones in seven of eight model pipelines, most notably in management.
